title: Towards a GraphNARX model for structural dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2610.23103v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The current paper introduces the GraphNARX model, a graph-based nonlinear autoregressive exogenous model for structural dynamics. The model is built to account for the geometry of structures and to model dynamic behaviour as the interaction between elements of the structure. Similar to other types of NARX models, GraphNARX is used for system identification. Nodal attributes of the graph encode past displacements and nodal forces, and the output of the model is the next-timestep displacement. The graph formulation of the model allows it to generalise to structures of different dimensions and degrees of freedom. Moreover, because graph-learning is performed locally between the nodes, the GraphNARX model can also learn to infer displacements of nodes for which data are not available, i.e.\ to perform virtual sensing. translated_title: 面向结构动力学的GraphNARX模型
translated_abstract: 本文提出了GraphNARX模型，这是一种基于图的结构动力学非线性自回归外生模型。该模型旨在考虑结构的几何特性，并将动态行为建模为结构各单元之间的相互作用。与其他类型的NARX模型类似，GraphNARX用于系统辨识。图的节点属性编码了过去的位移和节点力，模型的输出为下一时间步的位移。该模型的图表示形式使其能够泛化到不同维度和自由度的结构。此外，由于图学习是在节点之间局部进行的，GraphNARX模型还可以学习推断没有可用数据的节点位移，即执行虚拟传感。所提出模型的性能在系统辨识框架和虚拟传感框架下进行了评估，并取得……
tldr: GraphNARX是一种基于图的结构动力学非线性自回归外生模型，能够考虑结构几何特性进行系统辨识，可泛化至不同维度和自由度的结构，并支持虚拟传感功能。
en_tdlr: GraphNARX is a graph-based nonlinear autoregressive exogenous model for structural dynamics that accounts for structural geometry, generalizes across structures of different dimensions and degrees of freedom, and enables virtual sensing.
